description: The chart represents a multi-level categorization of data related to abusive language detection, with the central label "TIALD" indicating the overall topic. The chart is divided into 2 main categories and further sub-categories, totaling 18 slices. The two main categories are "Abusive" (teal) occupying roughly 55% and "Not Abusive" (yellow) occupying approximately 45%. Under "Abusive", the sub-categories include "Other Negative" (around 17%), "Political Negative" (about 17%), "Racial Negative" (approximately 3%), "Sexist Negative" (around 3%), and "Mixed" (less than 1%). Under "Not Abusive", the sub-categories are "Other Positive" (around 15%), "Neutral" (approximately 10%), "Political Positive, Negative, Mixed, Neutral" (around 8%), "Religious Positive, Negative, Racial, Sexist" (about 8%), and "Negative, Positive, Mixed, Neutral" (around 4%). The chart does not include a legend, and the labels are placed directly on the slices. The segments appear to be ordered in a way that groups related categories together, with the sub-categories generally arranged in a clockwise direction.
